package controller

// Fixture: every rule the reconciler checker claims to enforce, violated once,
// so a tightened rule that no longer fires is visible as a regression.

func (r *BadReconciler) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, req ctrl.Request) (ctrl.Result, error) {
	var thing Thing
	thing.Status.Phase = "Running"
	if err := r.Update(ctx, &thing); err != nil {
		return ctrl.Result{RequeueAfter: time.Minute}, err
	}
	controllerutil.AddFinalizer(&thing, "x")
	job := &batchv1.Job{}
	_ = job
	time.Sleep(time.Second)
	log.Fatal("gone")
	switch thing.Status.Phase {
	case "Running":
	}
	return ctrl.Result{}, nil
}
